observations: Baseline reconciliation for revision 1. Every criterion is contradicted: the site declares v5.6.3 while the newest release is v5.9.0, and no mechanism yet makes a stale declaration fail.

Count verification used the ops fork at the v5.9.0 release commit 37f5689 as REF=main, because that clone has no release tags fetched. A tagged clone should confirm the same numbers before the sync PR.

Independent check on 2026-10-17 with a tagged clone. REF=v5.9.0 exits 1 with 40 stale counts across 51 claims. REF=v5.6.3 exits 0 with all 51 agreeing. The verifier exits 1 on drift when run unpiped. Those totals include lines inside docs/orbit records, because the scan does not yet exclude that directory.

evidence: index.html carries three different versions: v5.6.3 five times, 5.6.2 once (the softwareVersion JSON-LD value), and v5.5.0 once.
llms.txt, llms-full.txt, index.md.gen, and AGENTS.md say v5.6.3. The newest published release is v5.9.0.
how-it-works.html, architecture.html, skills.html, 404.html, skill.md, and agent-permissions.json carry no version string at all.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: One version per page and manifest, equal to the declared tag. Next: Add a declared-tag file (ac2-1), then rewrite every version slot from it in one sync PR.

evidence: APEXYARD_REPO=<ops fork> REF=main .github/scripts/verify-counts.sh at the v5.9.0 release commit 37f5689 reports FAIL: 39 stale counts across 50 claims.
Hooks drift: pages say 60, the tag derives 62. Rules drift: README and architecture.md.gen say 25, the tag derives 22.
The ops fork has no v5.9.0 tag fetched, so REF=main at the release commit stood in for the tag.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: Counts on every surface equal the counts derived from v5.9.0. Next: Run verify-counts.sh against the declared tag and fix every DRIFT line in the sync PR.

evidence: skill.md names 66 skills. The framework at the v5.9.0 release commit ships 68 skill directories.
Missing from skill.md: /orbit and /scaffold. No retired skill is listed.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: Two skills shipped since v5.6.3. Next: Regenerate the skill.md list from the framework tree at the declared tag.

evidence: og/*.png were last rendered on 2026-08-12 by commit 6c38f61 at APEXYARD_REF=v5.4.0 (PR #67).
The cards therefore show v5.4.0 counts, three releases behind the pages and five behind the newest release.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: Cards rendered at the declared tag. Next: Run og/render.sh with APEXYARD_REF set to the declared tag in the sync PR and commit the four PNGs.

evidence: The site declares v5.6.3. gh release view --repo me2resh/apexyard returns v5.9.0, published 2026-10-15.
v5.7.0 (2026-09-27) and v5.8.0 (2026-10-08) were also never declared.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: Three releases. Next: Declare v5.9.0 in the sync PR after ac2-1 exists.

evidence: git ls-files shows no file whose purpose is to declare the framework tag.

The tag is stated as a source in README.md line 58 (At v5.6.3), in index.html, and in the manifests. verify-counts.sh requires REF on the command line and og/render.sh falls back to the newest tag in the clone.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: The single declared-tag file. Next: Add one tracked file holding the tag, make verify-counts.sh and og/render.sh read it when REF is unset, and remove the prose claims.

evidence: shell-tests.yml shellchecks verify-counts.sh and runs test-verify-counts.sh against a synthetic framework repo. No workflow runs the verifier against the site tree and a real framework tag.
shell-tests.yml triggers on pull_request with a paths filter, so a page-only change does not run it at all.
link-check.yml and preview-build.yml also carry paths filters. They check links and build artifacts, not counts. This PR, which changes only docs/orbit/, registered no check at all.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: A required check that runs verify-counts.sh against the declared tag on every pull request. Next: Add a workflow with no path filter that clones me2resh/apexyard with tags and runs the verifier.

evidence: README.md has no sync section. Its headings are What's here, How it deploys, Manually maintained content, CI.
README.md line 19 says the counts are updated by hand on each framework release.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: A sync section that names the declared-tag file and the release-line prose as the only hand edit. Next: Write it in the same PR that adds the file.

evidence: gh issue list --state open still contains all eleven: #46, #49, #54, #55, #60, #61, #64, #66, #69, #72, #85.
Each has at least one merged Refs PR, so the issues are open by convention, not because the work is missing.
criterionAssessments.explanation: Missing: Eleven closures with a comment linking this Plan. Next: Close ten after the sync PR merges. Close #72 only after its AgDR exists, per the Plan constraints.
